name: Brazilian Real — CDI (Pre x DI) curve

ladders.name: DI
ladders.notes: Pre x DI curve from B3 DI-futures (annualized BUS/252 exponential). Live mid/history/roll/z-score on the analytics board. DV01 is exact for a PAR point: a zero-coupon DI swap self-discounts, so dNPV/dr = N*(du/252)/(1+r) with no strip bootstrap. Marking OFF-MARKET/seasoned DI positions (own NPV, traded rate away from the quote) still needs the full BUS/252 zero-coupon engine. Legacy BCSW*PD swaps return no API px.

notes: BRL exposed via the DI-futures curve (no bootstrapped OIS/IRS - not needed for par points, since a zero-coupon DI swap self-discounts). 'brl 5y' -> 5Y DI level + history + roll + z-score + a real DV01; dated contracts ('brl f28') likewise. Traded offshore USD-settled (CME), where the USD discount factor cancels against the FX forward under CIP, so $01 = BRL DV01 x spot.
